title: Norwegian-Style Date Wrap
description: A sweet and savory fusion of Norwegian and Middle Eastern flavors, wrapped in a crunchy tortilla.
instructions: 1. Lay the tortilla flat on a clean surface.
2. Spread the beet hummus evenly over the center of the tortilla, leaving a 1-inch border on either side.
3. Arrange the dates on top of the hummus.
4. Sprinkle the toasted almonds over the dates.
5. Fold the bottom edge of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
6. Slice in half and serve immediately.
